alice_customer: Hey team — after our IdP rotated certs yesterday (2026-03-05T14:22Z) a subset of users (prod) are getting 403s on the SAML callback. We rolled the cert back but issues persist. Any ideas?

 eve_support: Sorry — can you paste the SP error lines from your logs and confirm if your IdP metadata URL changed around rotation?

 alice_customer: SP log: 'SAMLResponse rejected: Recipient mismatch. expected https://app.example.com/saml/acs but got https://app.example.com/saml/acs/'. Also seeing intermittent 'Signature verification failed'. IdP metadata URL unchanged.

 eve_support: Two clear signals: trailing slash mismatch on the ACS and signature failures. Can you curl your IdP metadata and paste the first KeyDescriptor blocks (trim certs)?

 maria_idp_admin: Pasting trimmed metadata snippet:
<AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.example.com/saml/acs"/>
<KeyDescriptor use="signing">
  <KeyInfo>...<X509Data><X509Certificate>MIIC...==</X509Certificate></X509Data></KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
Note: metadata is served behind a CDN with gzip + chunked responses.

 eve_support: We have seen cases where CDN chunking / partial responses cause our metadata watcher to cache a truncated XML (appears valid at first bytes but missing closing tags), which leads to signature/key discrepancies. Can you run locally and paste the xmllint output: `curl -svL "https://idp.example.net/metadata" | xmllint --format -`

 alice_customer: curl output looks fine from our side. We do have a second metadata endpoint behind LB: `https://idp.example.net/metadata?ver=rot2026` which 302s -> CDN url. It's possible the poller followed the 302 and got a 206/partial payload during rotation (HTML stub).

 sam_oncall: Escalating to eng-infra. @eve_support please flag — our polling code treats non-200 as retry but treats 206 as success currently. That could allow a partial file to be cached.

 eve_support: Workarounds: 1) From Redwood Console: Settings → Auth → 'Refresh IdP metadata' (forces refetch & validation). 2) Add a second ACS entry in your IdP with trailing slash `https://app.example.com/saml/acs/` so Recipient check will match existing mobile/legacy flows.

 jordan_eng_infra: Filed INF-2026: make metadata fetcher stricter — require full 200 + Content-Length match or valid chunked gzip completion, and verify EntityDescriptor signature before committing. Hotfix will treat 206 as failure.

 alice_customer: After forcing metadata refresh, errors dropped from ~80% to ~5%. Remaining rejects are from mobile SSO users.

 maria_idp_admin: Mobile flow uses legacy ACS with trailing slash. I'll add `https://app.example.com/saml/acs/` to AssertionConsumerService as an altLocation, and re-upload full cert chain (include intermediates). Also will disable CDN chunking for the metadata endpoint.

 eve_support: Perfect. After re-upload please paste the metadata checksum (sha256). We'll watch assertion logs. Also INF-2026 hotfix scheduled this afternoon — should reduce recurrence.

 alice_customer: Checksum: `sha256:b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184f0a1b2c3d4e5f67890abcd1234ef56789`. Thanks.

 sam_oncall: I'll monitor SAML assertion rejects for the next hour and confirm. If rejects persist after hotfix + metadata refresh we'll create a priority incident and capture full SAMLRequest/Response samples (PII redacted). :thumbsup:
